---
description: "Run evidence-first SecurityExpert root-cause analysis"
---

Work in `ROOT_CAUSE` movement. Do not modify code initially.

Use the smallest evidence/source set that can isolate the failure. Separate the
failing build from pre-existing known backlog behavior. Identify the exact
producer/consumer or protocol boundary, the first proven failure point and the
minimal closure scope. Recommend whether the fix is deterministic
IMPLEMENTATION or requires ARCHITECTURE/high reasoning.
